place.en: Black Pine Ridge · the broken stele

setup.zh: 马家的狗追到岭口一块断碑前，夹着尾巴不肯再走。碑上只剩「勿入」两字。爹说：你在这儿等我。
setup.en: The Mas' dogs chased you as far as a broken stele at the ridge mouth, and there they stopped, tails tucked, and would go no further. Only two characters are left on it: Do not enter. Father says: wait for me here.

recap.zh: 断碑前，你和爹定了三条规矩，跨进了黑松岭。
recap.en: At the broken stele you and Father made three rules, and stepped into Black Pine Ridge.

zh: 岭口一块断碑，半截埋在土里。
碑后松林，一点风都没有。
en: A broken stele at the ridge mouth, half buried.
Two characters left: Do not enter.
Behind it the pines, not a breath of wind.

text.zh: 两个字刻得极深，笔画里积满了黑泥，倒像刻字的人生怕后人看不清。
text.en: The two characters are cut very deep, their strokes packed with black mud, as if whoever carved them feared no one after would read them.

text.zh: 你捡了块石子扔进松林，石子落了地，竟没有一点声响。
text.en: You toss a pebble into the pines. It lands — and makes no sound at all.

label.en: The dead grass at its foot

text.zh: 碑脚下的枯草有半人高，一根根朝外倒着，倒像许多年前有人扒开过，又慢慢长拢了。
text.en: The dead grass at the stele's foot stands half a man high and leans outward, as if someone parted it long ago and it slowly grew back.

label.en: The white silk cord on the stele

text.zh: 碑脚一溜小脚印，比你的还小一圈，走进林子，没有走回来；碑身系着一截白丝绳，雨淋过了，还是白的。
text.en: At the stele's foot, a line of small footprints, smaller than yours, going into the trees and not coming back; round the stele, a white silk cord, still white after the rain.

story.zh:
石坳村的孩子，还不会走路，便听过黑松岭的故事。岭口立着一块断碑，半截埋在土里。一块青黑的石头，几百年风吹雨打，四周的石头都长满了苔，它身上一点不生，干干净净，像天天有人擦。碑上的字早就认不全了，只剩最后两个字，还看得清清楚楚：**勿入。**

村里的老人说，进去十个人，回来一个，回来的那一个，也不肯说里面有什么。小满的爷爷，便是没回来的那九个之一。

父子两个站在断碑前面。碑脚的泥地上，有一溜小脚印，比小满的还小一圈，一直走进林子里去，没有走回来的。

碑身上系着一截白丝绳，系得端端正正，雨淋过了，还是白的。石坳村没有人用得起丝绳。

碑后的松林黑沉沉的，没有风，也没有鸟叫，静得像有人把整座山的声音都装进口袋里拿走了。
story.en:
Every child in Shi'ao Village heard the tale of Black Pine Ridge before they could walk. At the mouth of the ridge stood a broken stele, half buried in the earth: a blue-black stone that had stood through centuries of wind and rain, and while every stone around it was furred with moss, not a speck grew on it — clean, as if someone wiped it every day. The words on it could no longer be made out, except the last two, still clear as day: **Do not enter.**

The old folk said that of ten who went in, one came back, and that one would never say what was inside. Xiaoman's grandfather was one of the nine who didn't come back.

Father and son stood before the broken stele. In the mud at its foot ran a line of small footprints, a size smaller than Xiaoman's, going into the forest. None came back out.

A length of white silk cord was tied round the stele, neatly knotted, still white after the rain. No one in Shi'ao Village could afford silk cord.

The pines behind it were dark and heavy; no wind, no birdsong — so still, it was as if someone had put the whole mountain's sounds in a sack and carried them off.

label.en: Look at the back of the stele

exits.means: looks at the back of the stele, as Granny Wu said; compares the token

story.zh:
小满想起吴婆婆的话，绕到碑后，扒开半人高的枯草，只见碑的背面也刻着字，比正面的更深、更小，弯弯曲曲的，他一个也不认得，只认得最底下刻着一只小小的狐狸，蜷着身子，尾巴绕着身子。他把怀里的木牌掏出来比了一比，竟是一模一样。

小满心里咯噔一下，看看木牌，又看看碑，又看看木牌，然后拿定了一个主意：把木牌收好，什么都不说。有些事说了出来，他爹今天便不会进去了；他爹不进去，马三便要来收弓；马三来收弓，他娘便又要蹲在地上捡东西。

这笔账，他算得清清楚楚。
story.en:
Xiaoman remembered Granny Wu's words, went round behind the stele and parted the dead grass, half as tall as a man: the back was carved with words too, deeper and smaller than the front, twisting and curling, not one of which he could read — except that at the very bottom was carved a small fox, curled up, its tails wrapped around its body. He took the token from his jacket and held it up beside it: exactly the same.

Xiaoman's heart gave a jolt. He looked at the token, then the stele, then the token again, and then made up his mind: put the token away and say nothing. Some things, once said, would mean his father didn't go in today; if his father didn't go in, Ma San would come for the bow; if Ma San came for the bow, his mother would be crouching on the floor picking things up again.

That sum he'd worked out perfectly clearly.

label.en: Make three rules, and go in with him

exits.means: goes in with father on conditions, sets rules, marks, turns back by sundown, runs if anything is wrong

story.zh:
小满没有说「我不」，想了一想，道：「爹。你的腿，追不上鹿。」他爹登时愣住了。

小满竖起三根手指，道：「我跟你进去。但咱们定三条规矩。一，每走一百步，我在树上刻一道记号。二，太阳一过那道山梁，不管追没追到，掉头就走。三——」他看着他爹的眼睛，「只要有一样东西不对劲，不管是什么，不商量。跑。」

他爹看着他，半晌，道：「好。听你的。」又道：「……你娘教的？」小满道：「嗯。」他爹长长地叹了一口气，那口气里一半是放心，还有一半，是有点吃醋。

他道：「随她。随她好。」

小满把那只山鸡拴在他爹背后的箭壶带子上。

两人跨过了断碑。跨过去的那一刻，小满耳朵里轻轻「嗡」的一声，像有人在很远很远的地方敲了一记钟。他回头看，断碑还在；往前走了几步，再回头时，断碑竟已没了。

他面不改色，在身边那棵树上刻下了第一道记号，手有点抖，刻歪了；便又在旁边刻了一道，这一回没歪。他当即决定，第一道不算。
story.en:
Xiaoman didn't say "I won't." He thought, then said, "Dad. Your leg can't catch a deer." His father stopped short.

Xiaoman held up three fingers. "I'm coming in with you. But we set three rules. One: every hundred paces I cut a mark on a tree. Two: once the sun's past that ridge, caught it or not, we turn back. Three —" he looked his father in the eye, "— the moment anything's wrong, whatever it is, no arguing. We run."

His father looked at him a long while. "All right. We'll do it your way." A pause. "…Your mother taught you?" Xiaoman said, "Mm." His father let out a long sigh, and in that sigh half was relief, and the other half was a little jealousy.

"Takes after her," he said. "Good that he does."

Xiaoman tied the pheasant to the strap of the quiver on his father's back.

The two of them stepped past the broken stele. The moment they crossed it there was a faint *hum* in Xiaoman's ears, like a bell struck very, very far away. He looked back: the stele was still there. A few steps on he looked back again, and the stele was gone.

Without a flicker he cut the first mark on the tree beside him; his hand shook a little and it came out crooked. So he cut another beside it, and that one was straight. He decided on the spot that the first didn't count.

exits.means: wants to go back to the village, gives up the hunt

story.zh:
小满道：「爹，咱回吧。」他爹没回头，道：「回去，弓就没了。」顿了一顿，又道：「没了弓，冬天拿什么打肉？拿我的膝盖？」

小满看了看他缠着麻布的膝盖。那膝盖今天一句话都没说。他也没再说话。
story.en:
Xiaoman said, "Dad, let's go home." His father didn't turn round. "Go home, and the bow's gone." A pause. "No bow, and what do we hunt meat with this winter? My knee?"

Xiaoman looked at the hemp-bound knee. It hadn't said a word all day. He didn't say any more either.

label.en: Leave Father here and go in alone

exits.means: wants to go in alone, leaving father behind

story.zh:
小满道：「你在这儿等我。我一个人进去。」他爹一把攥住了他的胳膊，攥得他生疼，道：「你爷爷，就是一个人进去的。」

他没再往下说。小满也没再提。
story.en:
Xiaoman said, "You wait here. I'll go in alone." His father seized his arm, gripping so hard it hurt. "Your grandpa went in alone."

He said no more. Xiaoman didn't raise it again.
